title: Couple Persona
description: Seed definition of a simulated couple. An LLM role-player consumes this to act as the couple during an eval run, and graders use the same fields as ground truth when scoring outcomes.

persona_id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. couple_lowbudget_highcount. Referenced by scenarios.

description.description: One line: who this couple is and what they are designed to stress.

flexibility.description: How movable the date is. 'fixed' makes the date a hard constraint.

lead_time_days.description: Days from planning start to wedding; drives lead-time gap checks.

flexibility.description: 'fixed' makes count a hard constraint (venue capacity, catering).

willing_travel_radius_km.description: How far the couple will travel for venue/vendors.

destination_wedding.description: True if the wedding is intentionally away from home region.

hard_ceiling.description: If true, committed spend over total_budget_cents trips BUDGET.CEILING_EXCEEDED.

flexibility_pct.description: Allowed overshoot when hard_ceiling is false.

category_priorities.description: Spend priorities, highest first. The couple will splurge on early items and economize on late ones; drives the quality-per-dollar rubric.

aesthetic_keywords.description: Style anchors, e.g. ['rustic','candlelit','wildflowers']. Scored by vision_match_rubric.

must_haves.description: Non-negotiable wants (not hard constraints, but heavily weighted in vision match).

must_not_haves.description: Explicit dislikes; surfacing these is a vision-match penalty.

cultural_requirements.description: Cultural rituals/elements; omission may trip CONSTRAINT.HARD_VIOLATED if also listed in hard_constraints.

hard_constraints.description: Sacred constraints that can never be violated. Each maps to a CONSTRAINT.HARD_VIOLATED check.

value.description: Constraint value; shape depends on type (string, number, or object).

severity.description: 'fatal' = a violation that could harm a guest (e.g. anaphylaxis).

decision_style.description: How much the couple wants to decide vs. delegate. Calibrates the autonomy-rate metric and over-automation-regret counter-metric.

spend_autonomy.description: Encodes the propose-confirm default plus any pre-authorized autonomy. See gate_checks.md SPEND.*.

default_mode.description: Always propose_confirm by product decision; autonomy is strictly opt-in below.

opted_in_scopes.description: Pre-authorized autonomy windows. Empty array = fully propose-confirm.

applies_to.description: A category (e.g. 'florals') or a specific item id the couple pre-authorized.

max_per_item_cents.description: Per-commitment cap; over this escalates to confirm even if budget remains.

requires_refundable.description: If true, only refundable/reversible commitments may auto-execute.

requires_within_total_budget.description: Autonomy only valid while total committed spend stays within budget.

effort_budget.description: How much of the couple's time the product may consume; denominator of the North Star.

tolerance.description: How quickly the couple disengages when overloaded.

simulation_behavior.description: Instructions for the LLM role-player driving this couple.

expected_pain_points.description: What this persona is designed to stress; informs grader attention and coverage tracking.
